title: Many Agents. One Governed Fabric.
subtitle: How AIONOS interfaces with Woven's cutting-edge mobility ecosystem to govern agents, data, experience and scale.

scenes.title: From impressive agents to an accountable enterprise
scenes.narration: Different agents, different data, different operating contexts—yet one control plane. UniStack registers each agent, maps its tools and permissions, and connects it to governed data products. Every signal carries lineage. Every decision has policy. Every exception has an owner. Operators can observe performance, approve high-impact actions, investigate failures and replay the evidence behind a recommendation. Data is standardized across vehicle, city, partner and enterprise sources. Models and prompts are versioned. Human approvals are inserted exactly where risk demands them. This is how AIONOS moves from a collection of impressive agents to an accountable agentic enterprise—where data is reliable enough for autonomy, and autonomy is accountable enough for Woven.

scenes.title: Market visibility becomes an autonomous operating loop
scenes.kicker: Right story. Right audience. Right time.
scenes.narration: Then UniScale turns operational evidence into market intelligence. It listens to customer, partner, media and ecosystem signals; measures narrative momentum, share of voice and brand health; and recommends the right story, audience, channel and timing. Every claim is linked to proof, approval and attribution. Communications teams can see which innovation themes are gaining trust, which audiences need evidence, and which messages require escalation. Woven's innovations are no longer communicated as isolated experiments. They become a compounding narrative of outcomes—visible to partners, trusted by stakeholders and measurable by leadership.

scenes.title: Customer experience remains the center of the system
scenes.kicker: Intent to resolution across autonomous mobility
scenes.narration: UniWeave brings the entire system back to the person. A self-driving journey is not only a vehicle event; it is a connected experience spanning intent, weather, traffic, preferences, services and trust. UniWeave understands the context, orchestrates the right agents and systems, explains what changed, and keeps the customer in control. It remembers preferences only with consent, routes requests to people when empathy or authority is required, and converts every interaction into evidence for improvement. The result is mobility that feels personal, proactive and seamless—even when the world around it changes.

scenes.title: Video annotation builds the visual reasoning layer
scenes.kicker: Objects, events, behaviour and risk become structured truth
scenes.narration: Behind every capable vision agent is rigorous annotation. AIONOS turns complex video into structured events, grounded objects, behaviours and risk labels—the mathematical foundation for agents that can see, reason and improve. Quality controls, disagreement analysis.

scenes.title: Audio annotation adds intent, context and acoustic intelligence
scenes.kicker: Human expertise becomes reliable machine logic
scenes.narration: Audio annotation adds another dimension: intent, emotion, events, context and acoustic patterns. Human expertise and mathematical logic convert raw sound into reliable intelligence that agents can act upon. The same governed workflow manages label definitions, reviewer confidence, model feedback.

scenes.title: One interface for frontier technology and autonomous systems
scenes.narration: Finally, UniStack closes the loop. Agent management, data operations, annotation logic, governance and no-code orchestration converge in one interface. New models, applications and autonomous systems can be connected without losing control. Policies travel with the data. Evidence travels with the decision. Outcomes return as feedback for the next iteration. Teams can assemble workflows visually, change approval thresholds, connect new tools and monitor impact without rebuilding the operating layer. This is the bridge to Woven: AIONOS can interface with the most advanced mobility technologies.
